acceptance.sat: A SAT model with no generated domination witness closes only this bounded structural separator. It is not an exact-seven repair until the complete Ramsey and edit-semantics verifiers pass.
acceptance.unknown: Every wall, cap, malformed or stale model, backend error, incomplete degree-16 enumeration, or no-novel-mask endpoint is UNKNOWN and learns nothing.
acceptance.unsat: UNSAT is proof-carrying evidence only after the exact final CNF and proof are independently authenticated and replayed. A raw solver exit remains UNSAT_UNCHECKED.

algorithm.degree16: For every degree-16 center v, enumerate nonedges {u,t} in F[Z_v] in lexicographic order and emit N(v) union {u,t}, stopping at the fixed per-model cap.
algorithm.degree17: For every degree-17 center v, emit every N(v) union {u} with u in Z_v.
algorithm.definition: Z_v consists of nonneighbors u of v with no common neighbor with v.
algorithm.independent_check: Every emitted mask must have cardinality 18 and be directly independent in the returned model before its 153-literal positive hitting clause is admitted.
algorithm.novelty: Canonical masks are deduplicated against the universal, historical, A+, and current-run families. An old-only violating model is fail-closed rather than accepted.

claim_boundary: This is a bounded structured independent-set separator. Its current checked-model audit exposes one new mask but establishes no exact-seven repair, branch refutation, repair radius, or global Ramsey bound.
proof_obligation: For any theorem-level UNSAT use, freeze the base CNF, all emitted mask records, the final CNF, the solver trace, and a fresh independent proof replay. If the four singleton units are installed, also bind and replay all four singleton proof chains.

production_mask_inputs.identity_policy: Production mode requires exact file SHA-256 and exact mask count, rejects final-component symlinks and non-regular files, rejects duplicate JSON keys and duplicate masks, and records each accepted basename, byte count, mask count, and digest in the audit JSON.

trusted_boundary: The scripted command-line runner does not invoke a solver. A live backend must implement the SolverBackend contract and remains outside this record until its exact formula, binary, result, and proof are authenticated.
